Title: Sign Language Recognition Analysis using Multimodal Data
Despite having similarity with the well-studied human activity recognition, the use of 3D skeleton data in sign language recognition is rare. This is because unlike activity recognition, sign language is mostly dependent on hand shape pattern. In this work, we investigate the feasibility of using skeletal and RGB video data for sign language recognition using a combination of different deep learning architectures.

answer: The paper's proposed architectures are an RNN architecture with a novel spatial data augmentation technique, and an architecture that uses both RGB and skeletal data to improve recognition accuracy [3]. It also employs LSTM networks, described as an architecture with an internal memory maintained via gates [13]. In its literature review, the paper additionally mentions Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and three-dimensional CNN used with RGB video data [6].
